title: Choose a skill with the AK SDLC map
scenario: Scenario: workflow-map. Open docs/map/workflow.html locally in a browser. No server or installed skill is needed to explore.

steps.title: Follow a stage and choose a method
steps.instruction: Find the Intent column in the canvas. Use + or wheel zoom if needed. Choose grill-me for a lightweight interview, or grill-with-docs when domain documents are needed. Open the chosen node.
steps.caption: The actual grill-me detail dialog from the shared super-board map engine.
steps.expected: When to use it explains the trigger. Expand How it works for usage, results and AK adaptations; Example for a concrete request; Sources for the authoritative skill. Escape closes the dialog.

steps.title: Find a skill by its trigger
steps.instruction: Search for glossary. Matching nodes remain bright while other nodes dim. Open domain-modeling in the Anytime band. Clear search to restore the full map.
steps.caption: The actual domain-modeling detail dialog. This method can be used across stages.
steps.expected: The dialog explains its trigger. Expand Sources to reach skills/domain-modeling/SKILL.md. A direct bookmark is workflow.html#skill-domain-modeling.
